title: Repeatable local model speed benchmark
goal: One command or documented procedure under evals measures uncached prompt reading and generation per local model
acceptance: A tool or doc under evals runs a fixed neutral prompt of about 3,900 tokens with the prompt cache defeated, and reports prompt reading and generation in tok/s per model, with machine, load and model digest
Run on the owner's Mac for gemma4:12b and gemma4:26b, with the result recorded in docs/evaluations/
privacy: Local models only; no paid route, prompts are neutral fixtures, raw reports stay private on their base.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-25: a timing run over the local model API with a fixed prompt, plus one recorded run. Not a measurement.
